Bill.BriefDescription: Exempting service contracts to administer parking and business improvement areas from excise taxation.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the taxation of contracts to administer parkingand business improvement areas; adding a new section to chapter 82.04RCW; and adding a new section to chapter 35.21 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.04 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: This chapter does not apply to amounts received by a chamber ofcommerce or other similar business association for administering theoperation of a parking and business improvement area as defined in RCW35.87A.110.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 35.21 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) A city shall not impose a gross receipts tax on amountsreceived by a chamber of commerce or other similar business associationfor administering the operation of a parking and business improvementarea within the meaning of RCW 35.87A.110. (2) For the purposes of this section, the following definitionsapply: p. 1 SSB 5999 (a) "Gross receipts tax" means a tax measured by gross proceeds ofsales, gross income of the business, or value proceeding or accruing. (b) "City" includes cities, code cities, and towns.
